record.paper_title: Negative Circles in Signed Graphs: A Problem Collection
record.original_question: Find a minimum-size family of positive circles whose edge sets cover all edges of a signed graph Σ.

evidence.quote: C5–8. Like C1–4, for circles that cover the edges of Σ.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A signed graph is a pair Σ = (G, σ) consisting of a finite undirected graph G = (V, E) (loops and multiple edges allowed) together with a sign function σ : E → {+1, −1}. A circle (also called a cycle) of G is the edge set of a simple closed walk in G. The sign of a circle C is the product ∏_{e∈C} σ(e); the circle C is called positive if this product equals +1.

A family 𝓕 = {C_1, C_2, …, C_k} of positive circles of Σ is said to cover the edges of Σ if every edge e ∈ E lies in at least one C_i.

Problem. Given a signed graph Σ in which every edge belongs to some positive circle, determine the minimum cardinality

   p_cov(Σ) := min { |𝓕| : 𝓕 is a family of positive circles of Σ whose union of edge sets equals E },

and describe (or find good bounds for) p_cov(Σ) in terms of structural parameters of Σ. Equivalently, find the smallest family of positive circles of Σ whose edge sets together cover all edges of Σ.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of covering all edges of a signed graph by a minimum number of positive circles is part of Zaslavsky's collection of open problems on circles in signed graphs. Recent literature (including a 2024 arXiv preprint on weakly negative circles and clustering, and Zaslavsky's lecture notes) continues to treat such packing/covering questions as open, with no general formula or characterization known.

status_evidence.title: Negative (and positive) circles in signed graphs: A problem collection
status_evidence.snippet: Lists problems on packing and covering of signed graphs by positive and negative circles as open questions.
status_evidence.claim: The covering problem for positive circles is recorded as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Weakly Negative Circles Versus Best Clustering in Signed Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) work continues to investigate circle structure in signed graphs, citing Zaslavsky's problem collection.
status_evidence.claim: No general solution to the minimum positive-circle edge cover has been published; the topic remains active.
